title: Telemetry Confluence: Model-aware normalization & routing for inference KPIs
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We currently receive a mix of Prometheus scrape metrics and OTLP-derived KPIs from serving nodes that are inconsistent in labels, histogram buckets, and exemplar linkage. This makes per-model SLO computation, cost attribution, and cross-deployment traces fragile.

Goal: Build a lightweight normalization + routing layer ("Confluence") that: 1) translates incoming Prometheus/OTLP telemetry into a canonical inference KPI envelope, 2) re-buckets histograms to SLO-aligned percentiles, 3) preserves exemplar -> trace linkage (span_id/span_trace), and 4) routes model-sharded telemetry to tenant-aware aggregation lanes for downstream rollups.

Scope: Ingest adapter (OTLP + prometheus remote_write), schema-stencil-based normalizer, exemplar stitcher, tenant hash router, backpressure controls, and a sidecar-compatible deployment mode for Dedicated and Private clusters. This ticket covers the engineering implementation and rollout plan for the pipeline adapter and canonical envelope v1.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter accepts OTLP metrics and Prometheus remote_write and emits canonical 'inference_kpi_v1' envelopes to the telemetry bus
Model identifier normalization: model_name/model_version labels standardized (mapping table + fallback heuristics)
Histogram re-bucketing implemented with configurable SLO buckets and validated against existing latency dashboards
Exemplar -> trace linkage preserved for 99.9% of exemplars (validated by test harness) using span_id/span_trace stitching
Routing: telemetry is partitioned by tenant_id and model_shard key and flows to tenant-specific aggregation lanes without cross-tenant leakage
Sidecar mode: basic resource profile and helm chart for Dedicated nodes included
Documentation: Confluence spec, example Grafana dashboard, and runbook for fallback behavior included
steps: Draft canonical envelope schema and schema-stencil (confluence/spec/envelope-v1) and review with PM/RESEARCH
Implement OTLP receiver with label harmonizer (normalize model_name/model_version, route prefixes)
Add Prometheus remote_write adapter that maps metric names to envelope fields and attaches exemplars
Implement histogram re-bucketer and SLO bucket config (config-driven with defaults)
Build exemplar stitcher that links exemplars to traces via span_id and fallbacks to request_id
Add tenant-hash router and partition key selection; integrate with existing aggregation lanes
E2E test harness (simulated serving traffic) that validates metric parity and exemplar coverage
Create sidecar Helm chart and resource profile for Dedicated; prepare upgrade notes for Private
Write Confluence spec, update Grafana dashboard examples, and publish runbook for ops
